subject: Child seat for Saturday
body:
Hi there,

I booked two e-bikes for this Saturday morning, booking LCW-4471. Would it be possible to add a child seat to one of them? My daughter is four.

Thanks,
Hannah Okafor

subject: Quote for cargo bikes
body:
Good morning,

We run a small parcel delivery team in the town centre and want to test cargo bikes before buying our own. Could you send us a quote for 15 cargo bikes for three months, including maintenance?

Best regards,
Tomasz Brenner
Operations, Brenner Logistics

subject: Brake not working - on the river trail now
body:
Hello, I am on one of your rental bikes on the river trail right now and the rear brake has stopped working completely. I am with my son, about 6 km from the shop, and we have stopped by the old mill. Booking LCW-4502. Please tell me what to do.

Priya

subject: Invoice NTS-2026-0419
body:
Dear customer,

Please find attached invoice NTS-2026-0419 for the April delivery of tyres and inner tubes. Total due: 1,240.00 EUR, payment terms 30 days.

Northgate Tyre Supply - Accounts receivable

subject: You have been selected for a FREE cruise!!!
body: Congratulations! Your business has been selected to win a luxury cruise for two. Click the link below within 24 hours to claim your prize. No purchase necessary.

subject: Gears skipping
body:
Hi,

my gears keep skipping when I climb, especially on the bigger cogs. Can I bring the bike in at some point this week?

Daniel

subject: Dead battery on Sunday
body:
Hello,

We rented two e-bikes last Sunday (booking LCW-4390). One battery died after about 10 km and we had to push the bike most of the way back, with two tired children. Nobody warned us the battery was not fully charged. I expect a full refund for that bike, otherwise I will write about this in a public review.

Grace Whitfield

subject: Re: Child seat for Saturday
body:
Sorry, one more thing: my partner is 1.55 m tall. Is the small frame you have for the e-bikes fine for her height?

Hannah

subject: Guided tour for our team
body:
Hello Larkspur team,

Our design studio would like to do a half-day guided bike tour in June as a team outing. We are 14 people, mixed fitness levels. Do you organise this, and what would it cost roughly?

Kind regards,
Sofia Lindqvist

subject: Change of date
body:
Hi, I have booking LCW-4488 for a hybrid bike. Can we move it from Wednesday 14 May to Friday 15 May? Same time if possible.

Thanks, Ben Carrow

subject: Your order 88213 has shipped
body: Good news! Your order 88213 (brake pads, 40 pairs) has left our warehouse and will be delivered by courier. Track your parcel in your account area. This is an automated message, please do not reply.

subject: Service booking
body:
Hi, I'd like to book my Trek FX 3 in for a full service. It has started squeaking from the bottom bracket and the chain looks worn. Any slot next week is fine.

Marta Kowalczyk

subject: Re: Gears skipping
body:
Hello again, I am still waiting for an answer about my gears. This is the second time I write. In case it helps, it's a Cube Kathmandu, about three years old.

Daniel

subject: Fleet policy renewal
body:
Dear policyholder,

Your fleet insurance policy PP-77120 expires at the end of the month. The renewal premium is 3,200 EUR. Please confirm the renewal by 30 May to keep your cover without interruption.

Pedalpath Insurance - Renewals

subject: Re: Dead battery on Sunday
body:
I haven't heard back from you. If I don't get my money back for the bike with the dead battery, I will dispute the card payment with my bank.

Grace Whitfield

subject: Cycling safety day in June
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We are planning a cycling safety day for 40 pupils aged 9 to 11 in June. Would you be able to supply bikes and helmets, and perhaps an instructor for the morning? We would be grateful for a proposal.

Yours faithfully,
The school office, Riverside Primary School

subject: Brake service not done properly
body:
I collected my Specialized Sirrus from your workshop yesterday after a brake service (job W-1187) and the front brake already feels spongy. I don't feel safe riding it to work. Honestly not happy with the work.

Ahmed Siddiqui

body: I am out of the office until 18 May with limited access to email. For urgent matters please contact the operations desk.

subject: Re: Child seat for Saturday
body:
Perfect, thank you, that is all sorted then. See you on Saturday!

Hannah

subject: Road bike for a week in July
body:
Hello, I will be visiting the area in July. How much is it to rent a road bike for a week, and do you have one in size L?

Kenji Watanabe

subject: Flat tyre
body:
Hi, I rented a bike from you this morning and the back tyre just went completely flat. I'm stuck at the north station car park and it's getting dark. What should I do?

Lena
